versions.content: Creation of SwcBswMapping For the RTE module con- figuration an implementation of the AUTOSAR Service described by a Basic Software Module Description needs to be selected. The SwcBswMap- ping to the corresponding SwComponentPrototype needs to be created ac- cordingly. For each SwcInternalBehavior one SwcImplementation is being created. The information for SwcImplementation should be generated based on the available information of BswImplementation 1 .
